Title: Hyperlapse for Azure Media Services available

Body.Content: We’ve released Hyperlapse Mobile and Hyperlapse Pro, two groundbreaking applications that offer Hyperlapse as a service to developers and media companies. In addition, we’ve released Hyperlapse for Azure Media Services, which integrates Hyperlapse technology with a media processor in the cloud. With the encoding-reserved-unit concept in Media Services, you can schedule scalable batch processing of your Hyperlapse tasks, parallelizing as many jobs as you need by virtually scaling up your hardware . For more information about Hyperlapse, please visit the Microsoft News Center. For more information about Hyperlapse for Azure Media Services, please read this Azure Hyperlapse blog post.
Body.Markdown:
We’ve released Hyperlapse Mobile and Hyperlapse Pro, two groundbreaking applications that offer Hyperlapse as a service to developers and media companies. In addition, we’ve released Hyperlapse for Azure Media Services, which integrates Hyperlapse technology with a media processor in the cloud.

With the encoding-reserved-unit concept in Media Services, you can schedule scalable batch processing of your Hyperlapse tasks, parallelizing as many jobs as you need by virtually scaling up your hardware .

For more information about Hyperlapse, please visit the Microsoft News Center . For more information about Hyperlapse for Azure Media Services, please read this Azure Hyperlapse blog post.
